title: I Don't Wanna Love Somebody Else (Live)

lines.original: Oh, I built a world around you
lines.translation: 噢，我打造了一个只属于你的世界

lines.original: Oh, you had me in a dream,
lines.translation: 噢，你让我做了场甜甜的梦

lines.original: I lived in every word you said
lines.translation: 我为你的一言一词而存活

lines.original: I thought that I found you
And I don't wanna love somebody else
Oh, we left it all unspoken
and now it's screaming in my head
lines.translation: 而现在它在我脑海中嘶吼着

lines.original: Oh, I shouldn't go on hoping
Oh, that you will change your mind
and one day we could start again
lines.translation: 想着某天我们会重归于好呢

lines.original: Well I don't care if loneliness kills me
I don't wanna love somebody else
lines.translation: 因为我已不想再去爱其他人了

lines.original: Oh, I thought that I could change you
Oh, I thought that we would be the greatest story that I tell
lines.translation: 我以为我们会像小说人物一样美好

lines.original: I know that it's time to tell you it's over
lines.translation: 现在我想是时候告诉你 一切都结束了

lines.original: But I don't wanna love somebody else
lines.translation: 我已没法再去爱其他人了阿
